## Motivation

Split #44747 into reviewable parts. This is the Beam CUDA Docker image part, position 1 of 8 in the merge order below. Its branch starts from #44747's merge base with main. No other part depends on it or includes it.

## Modifications

Adds `docker/beam/beam.Dockerfile`, a Beam serving image on top of `lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22`, following `docker/muse_spark/muse-spark.Dockerfile`. It clones the upstream `beam` branch (pin a commit with `BEAM_REF`) and installs it without dependencies. It then adds the two pins that branch needs on top of the release: OpenAI 2.8.0 for the Responses shell types and `nvidia-cuda-tileiras` 13.4.92 for the cuTile router GEMM. The Dynamo and `grpcio-tools` pins moved to #45292.

`docker/Dockerfile` is not changed by any part. This image is a stopgap: delete it once Beam runs from the main image.

This part changes **1 file (+31 / -0)** beyond the parts its branch carries.

## Validation

- Cut from #44747's head (`f7473673dd`) without modifying the `beam` branch, which stays the reference. Every branch starts from #44747's merge base with main (`5bcaf0f8ed`, Oct 13); the parts have not yet been synced with current main.
- Conflicts when merged into main `28448a86d4`: none.
- Coverage: #45253, #45361 and #45257 merged, plus the one-line #45290 and #45291 changes, give exactly the #44747 tree, except that streamed LoRA (25 files from `sglang-miles`) and Beam LoRA serving (10 files plus the LoRA hunks in 3 files) are left out, the five platform pyprojects keep OpenAI 2.6.1, and `docker/beam/beam.Dockerfile` is added. No other path differs.
- No part except #45290 and #45291 changes a pyproject, and none changes `docker/Dockerfile`. `environ.py` is split by hunk. Every changed Python file in this part parses.
- Not run for this split: pre-commit, registered-test registry parsing and the CPU and GPU suites. `docker buildx build --check` passes. The image builds on arm64 and amd64, and its exact environment serves Beam on GB300 and H200. Intermediate parts make no claim of standalone Beam serving validation; the recorded accuracy and performance results are in #44747.

## Merge order

Every part targets `main`. #44747 stays open, unchanged, as the full reference. Merge in this order:

1. #45253 — Beam CUDA Docker image
2. #45291 — OpenAI SDK 2.8.0, needed by the Responses shell tools in #45257
3. #45254 — Kernels
4. #45255 — Attention, memory and DFlash DP support
5. #45256 — Beam model, checkpoints and tests
6. #45257 — Beam reasoning, tool calls and response templates (also after #40478, #43941 and #40479)
7. #45290 — `nvidia-cuda-tileiras`, needed by #45361
8. #45361 — cuTile BF16x3 router GEMM (optional: without it Beam uses the cuBLAS router)

#45292 (Dynamo and `grpcio-tools` pins for the Beam image) is not in the merge order for now.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
+# Beam serving image (CUDA). Build from the repository root; application source
+# is cloned from upstream:
+#   docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --load \
+#     -f docker/beam/beam.Dockerfile -t beam:local-test .
+FROM lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22@sha256:e3a4f06001a29542fc4a8638536d9ffc5eb9c9942b08603c09b19a56eae4a1ae AS base
+
+SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]
+
+# Replace the stock SGLang with the upstream beam branch. Pass a commit SHA as
+# BEAM_REF to pin the source of a published image.
+ARG BEAM_REF=beam
+WORKDIR /sgl-workspace
+RUN git init -q /sgl-workspace/sglang-beam \
+    && git -C /sgl-workspace/sglang-beam fetch -q --depth 1 \
+        https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang.git "${BEAM_REF}" \
+    && git -C /sgl-workspace/sglang-beam checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD \
+    && uv pip uninstall sglang \
+    && uv pip install --no-deps -e /sgl-workspace/sglang-beam/python
+
+# Pins the beam branch adds on top of the v0.5.22 release: OpenAI 2.8.0 for the
+# Responses shell types and the cuTile compiler for the Beam router GEMM. Record
+# the new versions so later installs keep them.
+RUN sed -i -E '/^(openai|nvidia-cuda-tileiras)==/d' /sgl-workspace/constraints.txt \
+    && uv pip install -c /sgl-workspace/constraints.txt \
+        openai==2.8.0 nvidia-cuda-tileiras==13.4.92 \
+    && uv pip freeze | grep -E '^(openai|nvidia-cuda-tileiras)==' \
+        >> /sgl-workspace/constraints.txt \
+    && python3 -c "from importlib.metadata import version; assert version('openai') == '2.8.0'; assert version('nvidia-cuda-tileiras') == '13.4.92'"
+
+WORKDIR /sgl-workspace/sglang-beam
